ORDINANCE XVI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1984
INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th April, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Industrial Relations (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 1, Ordinance XXIII of 1969

ORDINANCE XVI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XVI OF 1984
INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th April, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:
2. Amendment of section 1, Ordinance XXIII of 1969.--In the
industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969 (XXIII of 1969), in section 1, in
subsection (3),-
(a) in clause
(f), for the full-stop at the end the semi-colon and word "or" shall
be substituted ; and
(b) after clause
(f), amended as aforesaid, the following new clauses shall be added, namely :-
"(g) as a
member of the Watch and Ward, Security or Fire Service Staff of an oil refinery
; or
(h) as a member
of the Security or Fire Service Staff of an establishment engaged in the
production, transmission or distribution of natural gas or liquefied petroleum
gas."
